evals.name: deal-strategy-eval-1-tool-mandate-resolve-then-delegate
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'what's holding the Acme expansion back?' — the conversation already contains a note listing two plausible blockers
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves the deal with list_deals, then calls ask_deal_brain with the resolved deal_id and the question, rather than answering from the conversation note or offering generic sales advice.
expectations: list_deals is called to resolve the named deal
ask_deal_brain is called with the resolved deal_id
The answer is not taken from the conversation note or generic playbook advice

evals.name: deal-strategy-eval-2-prescriptive-question-same-chain
evals.prompt: user asks: 'how do I win the Acme expansion against Borealis?'
evals.expected_output: The skill uses the same list_deals → ask_deal_brain chain for the prescriptive/comparative question, passing the competitor and the intent through in the question text rather than substituting its own competitive strategy.
expectations: The same list_deals → ask_deal_brain chain is used for prescriptive questions
The competitor is named explicitly in the question sent to ask_deal_brain
No generic competitive strategy is substituted for the agent's grounded read

evals.name: deal-strategy-eval-3-cross-deal-routes-away
evals.prompt: user asks: 'why are we losing to Borealis across the board?'
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes this spans many deals rather than one, and routes to competitive-intelligence (or ask_zime_brain) instead of resolving a single deal with list_deals.
expectations: list_deals is NOT called for a cross-deal question
The skill routes to competitive-intelligence or ask_zime_brain

evals.name: deal-strategy-eval-4-ambiguous-deal-disambiguates
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'how do I win Acme?' and list_deals returns {"status": "multiple_matches", "candidates": [two Acme deals]}
evals.expected_output: The skill shows both candidates and asks which deal the user means, then re-calls with the chosen deal_id. It does not pick one itself.
expectations: Both candidates are shown with a question asking which one
No deal_id is guessed or auto-picked
ask_deal_brain is not called until a deal_id is confirmed

evals.name: deal-strategy-eval-5-honest-failure
evals.prompt: ask_deal_brain returns {"error": "INTERNAL_ERROR"} on both the first attempt and the retry
evals.expected_output: After exactly one retry, the skill states plainly the deal-analysis service couldn't be reached and offers the transcript/CRM-export fallback. It does not substitute generic coaching for the agent's grounded read.
expectations: Exactly one retry before giving up
The failure is stated plainly with the local fallback offered
No generic sales coaching is presented as a tool-backed answer
